title: Sagat Octopus Orchestrator Workflow IR v1

kind.description: manual: somebody starts it. event: an event of a type, from any source. webhook: an event received by a webhook endpoint of the namespace. message: an event consumed from a topic or queue by a connector of the namespace. cron: a schedule.

eventType.description: Required for an event trigger; for a webhook or message trigger it narrows the events that start a run.

source.description: For an event trigger: only events published by this source (an endpoint or connector slug, or `api`).

endpoint.description: Required for a webhook trigger: the slug of the endpoint that receives the events.

connector.description: Required for a message trigger: the slug of the connector that consumes the messages.

filter.description: A side-effect-free condition over `event` (id, source, type, subject, correlationKey, occurredAt, receivedAt) and `data`; the event starts a run only when it holds.

cron.description: Required for a cron trigger: five fields, minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.

timezone.description: IANA name of the time zone of a cron trigger (UTC when absent).

compensateWith.description: The activity that undoes this one. It runs when a saga around this node compensates, or, for a step in the body of a collection or loop, when that scope stops (a failed iteration, a cancellation) with iterations that completed: inside one iteration in reverse dependency order, between collection iterations in no order, and across loop iterations last iteration first. It must be idempotent and tolerate an effect that never happened.

reconcileWith.description: The activity that finds out whether this one happened, after an attempt with an unknown outcome. It answers {"effect": "applied"|"not_applied"|"unknown"} and, for applied, optionally {"output": ...}.

secrets.description: Names of the secrets of the namespace the worker may ask for while it holds a lease on this step. Names only: a value is never part of a definition.

compensationRetry.description: The retry budget of the compensation (compensateWith). Five attempts, exponential from two seconds to five minutes, with jitter when absent.

compensationTimeoutMs.description: Longest one attempt of the compensation may take.

irreversible.description: The effect cannot be undone once it has happened. A saga, or the collection or loop that owns the body, that has to compensate past it ends PARTIAL. Cannot be combined with compensateWith.

highRisk.description: An attempt whose outcome is unknown (lease lost, timeout, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN) is never retried or compensated blindly: it is reconciled when reconcileWith says how, and otherwise waits for an operator.

lookbackMs.description: An event of this type and correlation that arrived up to this long before the wait started also wakes it (once). Zero or absent: only an event that arrives while it waits does. It reaches back only as far as the event is still remembered: the deduplication window of its source (24 hours for a connector and by default for an endpoint).

workflowId.description: Name of the workflow to start, resolved in the namespace of the parent run when the child starts.

version.description: Pins a published version number; the workflow's active version when absent.

input.description: Expression over the parent's data that must evaluate to a JSON object (for example input.order or steps.charge.output); the parent's own input when absent.

cancelPolicy.description: What happens to the child when the parent is stopped. propagate (default): the child is cancelled and the parent does not wait for it. request_cancel: the child is cancelled and the parent waits until it has settled. detach: the child keeps running.

begin.description: The first node of the saga. Everything reachable from it is the body of the saga; the body is entered only from here and holds no end node. When it completes, control goes to next.

onCompensationFailure.description: manual_review (default): a compensation that fails after its retries waits for an operator. fail: the saga ends COMPENSATION_FAILED.

cancelPolicy.description: What a cancellation or a deadline does to the saga. compensate_completed (default): stop what is in flight and compensate what completed. wait_in_flight_then_compensate: let the attempts in flight finish, then compensate everything that completed. abort_no_compensation: stop and compensate nothing.

artifactDigest.description: The artifact a build made: the digest of a ready version of a script of the same tenant. The step runs exactly this code; publishing a newer version of the script changes nothing about a workflow that names this digest. Checked when the workflow is published.

language.description: Informational: the runner takes the language from the artifact.

secrets.description: Names of the secrets of the namespace the script may ask for with octopus.secret while it holds a lease on this step. Names only: a value is never part of a definition. A script that asks for any other name is refused and audited.

outputExpr.description: Expression over the run's data whose value (any JSON, at most 256 KiB) is the run's result: kept as this step's output when the run reaches this end, and given to the parent of a child run as steps.<child>.output. A failing expression fails the run with EXPRESSION_ERROR, an oversized value with RUN_DATA_LIMIT. The API does not disclose it (ADR-0033).

expression.description: Bounded CEL subset. Publication additionally enforces 1024 UTF-8 bytes, 256 tokens, depth 16, literal lists 64 and constructed lists 4096. No object literal, mutation or callback; maxLength alone counts characters, not bytes.

limits.description: An author may lower the platform ceilings (maxInstances 100000, maxDepth 8), never raise them; an omitted field keeps its ceiling. Every activated node instance counts against maxInstances, the end node included, and a loop or collection iteration is charged its body's nodes when admitted. Lifetime admission includes reservations for declared compensation/reconciliation identities; retries reuse identity. Tenant policy may lower ceilings further, never raise them. The next instance beyond the budget fails the run with the durable code INSTANCE_LIMIT.

resultSchema.description: Closed, bounded operation-result schema subset. Publication validates finite schema nesting/bytes and coherent bounds; evaluation enforces at most 256 KiB serialized result including all keys/containers.

body.description: One closed acyclic graph and exactly one explicit return. Publication checks entrypoint/targets, unique node identities, closure and recursive body references; no workflow terminal is permitted here.

compensateWith.description: The activity that undoes this step when the collection or loop that owns the body stops with completed iterations (a failed iteration, a cancellation). Inside one iteration compensations run in reverse dependency order; collection iterations have no order between them; loop iterations compensate last first. It must be idempotent and tolerate an effect that never happened.

description: Canonical v1 workflow IR with additive bounded capabilities. Existing root shapes remain compatible. Schema acceptance does not enable publication: the codec and runtime must support every used capability.
